column1: # The prebuilt engine of the engine sources at this commit: its engine key
# (engine/scripts/engine-key.sh: the git trees of CHROMIUM_VERSION, args, patches,
# and //pane) and the SHA-256 of PaneCore-<chromium>-<key:12>.zip, an asset of the
# engine-<key:12> prerelease, which the update check, reading the latest release,
# never sees. engine/scripts/publish-engine.sh publishes it and overwrites the
# line. A tag reads its own tree's, and every key shipped stays a prerelease.
